stage: User-concept construction detail and actual legacy/imported GLB feedback reviewed; final user/client acceptance separate

iterations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Studio design reference for a fictional spacecraft model in a 3D game. The attached original pixel-art views are the authority for silhouette and colors. Model the same assembly: two thick chamfered square-section grey blocks arranged in tandem along one horizontal axis, joined by a short, much narrower rectangular connector. Leave open space around that connector. Each outside end has a thin straight axial rod with a small muted red tip. The two blocks dominate the mass. Pale blue-grey opaque metal bands wrap around the blocks, with a few seated grey service covers and small slots. Sparse maintenance details on broad surfaces, restrained joint grime, scuffs, scratches and shallow dents. No added components or dense panel grids. One large elevated side three-quarter view, one matching side view showing both blocks and rods, and one end view; every view depicts identical geometry. Neutral studio lighting, charcoal backdrop, no text. Preserve the original simple angular shape rather than inventing a streamlined vessel.

input_images.role: Actual paletted legacy shape and colour reference

findings: Tandem chamfered square blocks, narrow open-sided central link and opposite red-tipped axial rods are readable and consistent.

Broad surfaces and restrained use marks fit the established Mauna treatment.
